title: I lost an ESP32
content: Somewhere between cleaning my desk at work and arranging monitors, one of my ESP32 boards disappeared.
The ESP32 has officially entered another dimension.
And the worst thing is that it was one of the new ESP32 S3 and it has been already uploaded with Monbit version!
I just realised that I noticed it is gone on Monday. Since then, nothing new.

title: I found an ESP32
content: The ESP32 miraculously emerged from the another dimension - it was under one of the monitor!
I was very surprised. I moved my monitor a bit to adjust its postition and then I noticed there is something under it. What a pleasant surprise when I took it out and it was the ESP!
Of course I was looking everywhere at desk and I assumed it fell into the bin but no. It was under the monitor the whole time.
